privacyNotice.heading: Contact Form Privacy Notice: {title}
privacyNotice.title: Contacting Humraah
privacyNotice.p1: If you contact Humraah through this form, we will use the information you submit to read and respond to your message and to follow up where needed. Please share only the information necessary for your enquiry. Do not include passwords, identity-document numbers, detailed financial records or other sensitive personal information in the message.
privacyNotice.p2: Your message may be accessible to the Humraah team members responsible for managing enquiries. Before this form goes live, Humraah will confirm who can access submissions, where they are stored, how long they are kept, and how a sender can request correction or deletion. We will update this notice to reflect those practices. If you are under 18, consider asking a trusted adult for help before sharing personal information online.

about.title: Humraah means “companion”.
about.intro: A youth-led initiative giving girls the information, resources and support to pursue higher education and build their own paths forward.

name.title: The name
name.text: Humraah means companion: someone who walks the journey with you.

problem.title: The problem
problem.text: In Pakistan, many girls who get an education stop at FSc, even when they want to continue. Not always because they don’t want to. Often because no one showed them how.

work.title: What we do
work.text: We give girls the information, resources, guidance and support to explore their own path, no one else’s.

privacy.title: Privacy and disclaimer
privacy.metaDescription: How Humraah's information should be used, and what happens to messages sent through the contact form.
privacy.disclaimerP1: Humraah shares information to help you plan your higher education. We take care to check it against official sources, but fees, dates, eligibility and requirements change, and some entries have not been verified yet. Always confirm the details on the official website of the university, scholarship provider or Higher Education Commission (HEC) before you apply or pay anything.
privacy.disclaimerP2: Humraah is an independent, youth-led initiative. We are not part of HEC, any university or any scholarship provider, and a listing on this site is not a ranking, a recommendation or a guarantee of admission or funding. Links to other websites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for their content.
privacy.disclaimerP3: Spotted something wrong or out of date? Email us at <email></email>.
